record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce only training-frequency input modulation from 0.02 to 0.01: scale real-item inputs by 1 + 0.01*tanh(standardized log1p training counts). The improvement from 0.04 to 0.02 motivates testing further attenuation while retaining the count-based feature. Keep padding and mask scales at 1. Preserve embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer; save scales in each category’s single checkpoint.
